srd_section: Playing the Game / Combat / Making an Attack; Equipment / Weapons and Armor; Rules Glossary / Unarmed Strike
adaptation_notes: Attack bonus is the Strength (Dexterity for ranged, better of the two for Finesse) modifier plus proficiency for a trained weapon category or weapon plus magic bonus; damage adds the same modifier; AC follows unarmored/light/medium/heavy armor. Unarmed strikes are always proficient and deal 1 + Strength with no die to double on a critical hit. Every hit deals at least 1 damage. Shields, armor training penalties, and non-weapon attack modifiers are deferred.

Bonus Action self-heal using the SRD 1d10 die. There is no level stat, so the SRD "+ Fighter level" bonus is a flat +2 matching a level 1-2 Fighter, and the two uses refill at the next encounter because no rest system exists.

Marks a downed actor unable to act and prone; the single-hero game ends immediately instead of entering death saves.
